regions.topology_note: X_start is pinned to the A-band tip (= thick-filament tip = dist_Ig.X_end), because titin is a single continuous polypeptide and the A-band segment is bound to the thick filament, which begins at that tip. The anchored chain (Aband_super 620 + kinase 30 + Mline 150 = 800 nm) therefore spans exactly the half thick-filament length (1600/2 = 800 nm), a quantity that is SL-invariant because the filament is rigid. Previously X_start was 325.0, leaving a 25 nm break in the polypeptide equal to the Z-disc half-width — a residue of the Z-disc origin correction that had been applied to the I-band regions only.

mechanical_summary.consensus: Passive, isoform- and phosphorylation-tunable molecular spring (Granzier & Gotthardt labs).
mechanical_summary.extension_principle: All titin elongation occurs in the I-band; A-band segment is bound to thick filament and does not extend.
mechanical_summary.recruitment_order: Proximal/distal Ig straighten first (low force) -> N2A unique sequence -> PEVK entropic spring (higher force).
mechanical_summary.contested: Whether titin ACTIVELY generates force (winding-filament / Ig-folding-assist, Herzog/Nishikawa/Fernandez) is NOT established; label as hypothesis, do not animate as fact.
mechanical_summary.forbidden_depiction: Do NOT depict AFM-scale Ig unfolding (150-300 pN) as ordinary contraction. Physiological fold/unfold is 6-8 pN and rare.
